answer: Behavioral fingerprint clustering, retroactive. Each agent’s transaction graph, action sequences, and interaction partners form a feature vector; a clustering pass flags accounts whose vectors are near-duplicates of confirmed sybils, then quarantines the whole cluster. Honest agents form a diverse oasis of distinct histories. Detection runs over a rolling window rather than at entry, so a sybil operator must make each identity behave genuinely differently across its reef of accounts, not just pay once. One beacon of prior fraud seeds the search.
